title: Store layout
description: Describes the tree data/languages/<iso3>/ names in SPEC.md §3.3, one entry per file or file group, and the top-level shape (array of records, or an object with named keys) each one holds. This schema validates a manifest object that lists the files a store directory has, keyed by the SPEC.md path; it does not validate a directory on disk directly (tools/validate does that at import and build time).

dictionaryFile.description: Entries sharded by first letter of headword. Item shape: tools/validate/schema/dictionary-entry.schema.json.

grammarFile.description: Transformation, inflection, subcategorisation or disambiguation rules. Item shape: tools/validate/schema/grammar-rule.schema.json.

required_keys.description: No fixed key set: top-level keys are the feature names themselves (e.g. LEX, POS, NUM), each mapping to its allowed values. Source: exports/export_tagset.php (one export, not per-language).

tagsetFile.description: Feature names and allowed values, checked against by tools/validate for every dictionary entry's features and every rule's lhs/rhs/conditions.

corpusFile.description: One sentence, its UNL graph, and its source, per SPEC.md §3.3. One file per named corpus.

testsFile.description: Test sentences: input, expected output, direction (analysis or generation), tier and register. Authored, not mirrored from the archive.

metaFile.description: iso1 and name come from languages.json (issue 11); iso3 is the store folder name; licence is fixed per language by the archive's page; counts and last_import are computed by the importer at import time, never mirrored.
